title: Day 701 — Sheinbaum Unveils Redesigned Mañanera Stage, Breaking From AMLO-Era Set
detail: On September 2, 2026 (Day 701, Wednesday), President Sheinbaum resumed her morning press conference — now used for the "glosa" (line-by-line follow-up) of her Second Government Report — on a newly redesigned stage at the National Palace, the first change to "La Mañanera" set since López Obrador introduced the format in 2018. The old flat burgundy-and-white backdrop was replaced with three panels — two angled outward — forming a semi-curved space, still using burgundy, white and gray tones and retaining the "Conferencia de Prensa" screen. Reporters now sit noticeably closer to the podium than the roughly four-meter distance under the old layout; Sheinbaum remarked, "Ya los veo más cerca, antes casi no los veía." She said the redesign came from her presidential staff rather than any deliberate political signal.

title: Day 701 — Sheinbaum Calls Zacatecas Car Bombing "Isolated," Sends Security Cabinet Sept 5
detail: On September 2, 2026 (Day 701, Wednesday), asked about the August 30 car bomb attack outside the Ojocaliente, Zacatecas police command, President Sheinbaum called the incident "isolated" while acknowledging it was not the first such attack, and announced her Security Cabinet would travel to Zacatecas on Friday, September 5 to present findings on the criminal group responsible. She separately urged UNAM to consider opening additional undergraduate spaces and faculty positions after the university opened 2,000 new spots, and cited figures from Legal Counsel Luisa María Alcalde crediting the administration with 27 constitutional reforms and 76 secondary-law reforms since October 2024. Sheinbaum also praised customs and tax authorities for a fuel-theft crackdown, citing the arrest of Fernando Farías Laguna as helping curb contraband and stabilize gasoline prices, and rejected suggestions of a rift with Morena Senate leader Adán Augusto López, saying their direct contact had lessened but coordination with other party leaders continued.

media.caption: Sheinbaum addresses the Zacatecas car bomb attack at her mañanera
